# DRUMSTARZ

Drum school in Riga, Latvia. Individual drum lessons, group percussion, kids parties, adult events, gift cards, and a summer camp.

Default language is Latvian. Russian: /ru. English: /en.

## Site

- Home: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/
- Teachers: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/trainers
- Contacts: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/contacts
- Percussion: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/percussions
- Events: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/events
- Kids: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/kids
- Gift card: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/giftcard
- Summer camp: https://drumstarz.vercel.app/camp
